notes.title: Shape Cascade vs COVID-19
notes.notes:
From march 13 until march 16 Shape Cascade will be discounted to help COVID-19 emergency.

I'll give the [b]ENTIRE [/b] revenue of these three days to [h1]Alessandria Hospital[/h1]

Is one of the Italian city most attected by COVID-19. This is a tiny game, but maybe it can help to buy some medical stuff.
